title: On Locational Marginal Emissions in Electricity Markets: A Two-Layered Dispatch Mechanism and Its Fundamental Theorems
summary: We propose a market design for real-time electricity markets that utilizes a two-layered dispatch mechanism to systematically incorporate carbon accounting into grid operations. In this mechanism, ``dispatch'', the centralized allocation of generation resources to meet system load, is executed via a hierarchical structure where the first layer minimizes financial costs to maintain economic efficiency, while the second layer minimizes system emissions strictly within the set of cost-optimal solutions. We define locational marginal emissions (LMEs) as the marginal rate of system emissions…
